caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing male figure dressed in a fringed garment, colored primarily in shades of brown and tan. The figure is adorned with a headdress featuring three large feathers, which extend upward from the head. His expression is solemn, and his long hair drapes over his shoulders. The statue holds a cylindrical object in his left arm and a bundle or package in his right hand that is held against his chest. The figure stands barefoot on a two-tiered rectangular base colored in light grey and beige tones. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Wooden Indian
